- Later, for irrelevant records (name mismatch): logOrThrow may throw WireParseException if throwOnIrrelevantRecord.

- For disallowed type: logOrThrow may throw.

- For NS handling: several logOrThrow calls: if !sname.subdomain(rrset.getName()), if NXDOMAIN/NODATA, if duplicate NS (already had NS). All can throw if throwOnIrrelevantRecord true.

- For DNAME multiple entries with throw true covered.

- For NameTooLongException with throw true covered.

- For CNAME multiple entries with throw true covered.

- For switch case (forbidden types) maybe not covered with throw true. There is group "Authority section – forbidden types (switch case)" with throw false only. Not test for throw true.

- For disallowed type in authority with throw true not covered.

- For type mismatch in answer with throw true not covered.

- For irrelevant record in answer (name mismatch) with throw true covered.

- For logOrThrow in answer for type mismatch (non-ANY) not covered.

2. Authority section forbidden types (DNAME, CNAME, A, AAAA) with throwOnIrrelevantRecord = true => expect WireParseException.

3. Authority section disallowed type (e.g., SRV) with throwOnIrrelevantRecord = true => expect WireParseException.

4. Possibly Authority NS subdomain mismatch with throw true already covered.

5. Maybe scenario where logOrThrow is called for irrelevant RRset in authority due to disallowed type (already covered by 3).

6. Also scenario where DNAME handling: when DNAME size >1 already covered.

7. NameTooLongException already covered.

- "Authority section – forbidden types with throwOnIrrelevantRecord true"

- "Authority section – disallowed type with throwOnIrrelevantRecord true"
